register.labelZh: COVER 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cover something up 可以描述用另一件物件遮住喉管、污痕、電線或未完成的地方。；cover something over 可以表示泥土、布、雪或其他物料鋪在某物的整個表面上。；cover something up 和 cover up for somebody 可以描述隱瞞真相，或替做錯事的人掩飾。；cover up 可以描述保護皮膚免受猛烈陽光、寒冷天氣或昆蟲影響。
register.summaryEn: Cover something up can describe hiding pipes, marks, wires and unfinished areas behind another object. Cover something over can show that soil, cloth, snow or another material has been placed over the whole surface. Cover something up and cover up for somebody can describe hiding the truth or protecting someone who has done something wrong. Cover up can describe protecting your skin from strong sun, cold weather or insects.
